name: Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor
author: kishorrajpurohit

sections.description:
Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor is an advanced Elementor widget designed to help you display stunning client reviews, ratings, and video testimonials beautifully. Whether you want a clean minimalist look or a modern dynamic slider, this widget provides you with 4 carefully crafted templates and extensive styling options.

Features

  • 4 Unique Layout Templates: Choose from Classic, Modern, Minimal, and Focused designs.
  • Text & Video Support: Display standard text reviews or embed YouTube/Vimeo video links.
  • Elementor Native: Works seamlessly inside the Elementor page builder.
  • Advanced Styling Controls: Deep customization for typography, colors, padding, and backgrounds.
  • Swiper Powered Slider: Smooth touch-friendly carousel using the latest Swiper.js.
  • Fully Responsive: Adapts perfectly to desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any page with Elementor.
  4. Search for ‘Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor’ in the widget panel.
  5. Drag and drop the widget onto your page and start adding testimonials!
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin is an add-on widget for the Elementor Page Builder plugin, which must be installed and activated.

Can I use video testimonials?

Absolutely! You can select “Video” as the testimonial type and paste a YouTube or Vimeo embedded URL.

Can I change the slider colors?

Yes, you have full control over card backgrounds, typography, star colors, and shadows directly in the Elementor Style tab.
